title: Exploring the Determinants of Employer-Provided Bus Usage in Penang, Malaysia
core_idea: Investigate the primary factors (socioeconomic, psychological, logistical) that influence employees' decisions to use employer-provided bus services in Penang by surveying 123 government workers and applying principal component analysis to 18 measured variables.
tldr: This study analyzes which socioeconomic, psychological, and logistical factors shape use of employer-sponsored bus services among Penang government employees, using a survey and PCA to identify underlying determinants to inform transportation program design.
